articles.conclusion: The takeaway is that managers should prioritize concrete risk assessments over sensationalist narratives, focusing on proven vulnerabilities rather than presumed systemic cyber threats.

articles.conclusion: Granting the loopholes could weaken domestic copyright safeguards and create a global precedent, jeopardizing creators’ earnings and control over Australian cultural assets.

Wetstone U.S. Ventures paid $6 million for the lease
The lease is for mapping and preparation, not for mining operations
The sale was the first-ever deep‑sea mining lease in U.S. waters
A federal judge objected to the lease sale
articles.conclusion: The deal establishes a legal and financial precedent for deep‑sea mining in U.S. jurisdiction, signalling future operational and regulatory considerations for the industry.

articles.title: "Sin nuestro territorio, la vida será muy difícil": quiénes son los awá, el grupo de indígenas aislados de Brasil que hizo un contacto inusual con otra comunidad
articles.que_paso: Tres miembros del pueblo awá — Amakaria, Jakarewyj e Irahoa — abandonaron su aislamiento en la selva amazónica tras la presión de madereros y del Gran Proyecto Carajás, y buscaron refugio en una comunidad que mantiene contacto con no indígenas. En noviembre de 2026, veinte awá aparecieron en la Tierra Indígena Arariboia, tras recibir ayuda de la comunidad guajajara de Tawari. El hallazgo fue documentado por la ONG Survival Brasil.
datos: Los tres awá fueron encontrados por primera vez por Sarah Schenker a finales de 2015 en una comunidad sedentaria cercana a su territorio original.
El Gran Proyecto Carajás, iniciado en la década de 1980, incluye la mina de hierro a cielo abierto más grande del mundo, una red ferroviaria y carreteras que atraviesan la selva.
El lunes 16 de noviembre de 2026, 20 awá se presentaron ante un puesto de la FUNAI en la Tierra Indígena Arariboia, estado de Maranhão.
Los awá recibieron ñame de los indígenas guajajaras (tenetehar) de la aldea Tawari, según informó Survival Brasil.
Sarah Schenker es directora de la ONG Survival Brasil y coautora del informe "Resistir para existir: la lucha global de los pueblos indígenas en aislamiento" publicado en 2025.
articles.conclusion: El contacto reciente evidencia la vulnerabilidad de los awá frente a la expansión minera y maderera, subrayando la urgencia de reforzar la protección de sus territorios y de prevenir nuevas exposiciones a enfermedades y violencia.

articles.title: Judge Finds Trump’s Planned Seabed Mining Auction Violated Law
articles.que_paso: A federal judge ruled that the Trump administration's plan to auction seabed mining rights off American Samoa breaches federal law. The decision casts doubt on whether the lease sale scheduled for Thursday will proceed.
datos: A federal judge ruled the planned seabed mining auction violated law
The auction was to be a lease sale for companies to mine the ocean floor
The lease sale was scheduled for Thursday
The targeted area is the ocean floor off American Samoa
The plan was initiated by the Trump administration
articles.conclusion: The ruling highlights legal obstacles to offshore resource projects, warning operators that compliance is essential and potentially delaying US access to strategic minerals.

articles.title: Light The Fire Premiere “Ghost Story” Music Video
articles.que_paso: Texan metalcore band Light The Fire, recently signed to Seek And Strike, issued a new music video for their track 'Ghost Story' ahead of the November 20, 2026 release of their EP 'I Won’t Be There To Save You'. The video explores themes of detachment and spectatorship, echoing the narrative of the A24 film 'A Ghost Story'.
datos: Light The Fire is a metalcore band based in Texas.
The band signed a recording contract with the label Seek And Strike.
Their EP titled 'I Won’t Be There To Save You' is scheduled for release on November 20, 2026.
A music video for the song 'Ghost Story' was released on the same day as the EP announcement.
The song 'Ghost Story' draws inspiration from the A24 film 'A Ghost Story'.
A band spokesperson said the song is written from the perspective of being checked out from everyday life, feeling like a spectator rather than a participant.
articles.conclusion: The coordinated video and EP launch demonstrates how aligning music releases with cinematic references can amplify audience engagement, a tactic worth considering for cross‑media marketing strategies.

articles.title: Meta’s Muse Charm might cost $300
articles.que_paso: Meta announced that its Muse Charm device, a handheld gadget enabling voice interaction with a Muse AI agent, will be priced at $300 and is slated to ship before the December holidays. The rollout includes a free 12‑month 5G data plan from Verizon and follows earlier statements by CEO Mark Zuckerberg and a spokesperson update on November 19.
datos: Muse Charm price set at $300, according to The Information.
Device scheduled to ship in time for the December 2026 holiday season.
Includes a complimentary 12‑month 5G data plan provided by Verizon.
Features a fingerprint sensor for instant activation without unlocking a phone.
Meta’s smartwatch version has been delayed to a 2027 launch.
Meta spokesperson Tyler Yee confirmed details on November 19, 2026.
articles.conclusion: At $300 the Muse Charm positions Meta in the premium AI‑hardware market, and the bundled 5G plan and holiday timing suggest a push to drive early consumer adoption despite the high price.

articles.title: A qué hora y dónde ver el debate entre Sánchez y Feijóo: todas las cadenas que emiten el cara a cara
articles.que_paso: La Academia de Televisión organizó un debate entre los líderes del PSOE y del PP, marcando el primer enfrentamiento directo en la campaña electoral. El encuentro se produce en la recta final del proceso electoral, con ambos candidatos buscando consolidar su posición de cara a las próximas elecciones generales.
datos: La Academia de Televisión es la entidad organizadora del debate.
El debate se celebrará el jueves 19 de noviembre de 2026.
La transmisión comenzará a las 22:00 hora peninsular.
Participarán Pedro Sánchez (PSOE) y Alberto Núñez Feijóo (PP).
Se emitirá en la web de EL PAÍS y en las principales cadenas de televisión españolas.
articles.conclusion: Este primer cara a cara puede influir decisivamente en la opinión de los votantes antes de las elecciones, ofreciendo a los partidos una oportunidad clave para diferenciar sus propuestas.

articles.title: Second Harbour’s “Cyclical” Video Debuts
articles.que_paso: Second Harbour released the online premiere of the music video for their new song “Cyclical,” marking the trio’s first fresh material in almost a year. The band says the track lets them explore new musical territory beyond their previous limits.
datos: The video was directed by Alex McFarland.
The song “Cyclical” is the first new release from Second Harbour in nearly a year.
Bassist Vincent Morency provided a public comment about the track’s purpose and sound.
The video debuted online (date not specified in the article).
Second Harbour is a Canadian emo‑rock trio.
articles.conclusion: The release signals the band’s strategic shift toward broader creative expression, suggesting upcoming releases may affect their market positioning and fan engagement.

articles.title: Who are Anthropic’s seven co-founders, now worth $180bn?
articles.que_paso: Anthropic's IPO priced shares above expectations, causing the seven co-founders' combined net worth to exceed $180 billion before settling at about $160 billion as the stock closed at $97.17. The company set aside 5% of its equity for a Public Benefit Fund and highlighted the involvement of its founders—physicists, a former journalist and a papal associate—in the effective altruism movement, while co‑founder Dario Amodei voiced concerns about AI safety and potential job losses.
datos: Total co‑founders' fortunes topped $180 billion on the IPO day
Closing share price was $97.17, valuing the co‑founders' stakes at just over $160 billion (~$23 billion each)
Sound Ventures' stake was valued at approximately $8.75 billion
5% of Anthropic's shares were allocated to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund
Anthropic employs 5,300 staff who will receive shares from the flotation
Amodei warned AI could eliminate half of all white‑collar jobs by the end of the decade
articles.conclusion: The valuation underscores the massive financial stakes in AI development, while the public‑benefit allocation and safety warnings signal operational risks and societal responsibilities that leaders must manage.

articles.title: Google is putting AI chats right on the homepage
articles.que_paso: Google added a collapsible sidebar to its desktop homepage that displays recent AI Mode chats and lets users start new threads, search past threads, or link a Gemini Notebook. The feature was announced by Google vice‑president of product Robby Stein in a post on X, extending the AI Mode interface that debuted last year.
datos: Robby Stein, Google vice‑president of product, posted a GIF on X showing the new sidebar
The sidebar is opened by clicking a gray bar on the left side of the Google homepage
It lists AI Mode searches and offers options to start a new thread, search threads, or connect a Gemini Notebook
Google rolled the sidebar out globally on desktop in November 2026
Google introduced the AI Mode button to the search bar in 2025 and expanded the search box in May 2026 for longer queries and AI‑powered autocomplete
articles.conclusion: The integration makes multi‑step AI‑driven searches more accessible directly from the homepage, potentially increasing user reliance on Google’s conversational tools and shaping how businesses design search‑centric workflows.

articles.title: Google turns to Blue Origin for a rocket, but its long-term problem remains
articles.que_paso: Google has partnered with Blue Origin to launch a set of data‑center‑scale satellites on the New Glenn rocket in 2029 as part of its Project Suncatcher moonshot to put AI compute in orbit, a step taken while the company evaluates long‑term launch options. The move comes amid industry concerns that without ultra‑low‑cost heavy‑lift capability, orbital data centers may never be economically viable compared with terrestrial facilities.
datos: Blue Origin will use the New Glenn 7×2 variant for the Google launch scheduled in 2029
Each satellite will have computing capacity roughly equivalent to a data‑center rack and will be placed in Sun‑synchronous orbit
Google’s target launch cost for orbital data centers is $200 per kilogram, projected for the mid‑2030s
The New Glenn 7×2 has flown three times before; a larger 9×4 variant is planned for the 2030s
SpaceX’s Starship V3 is currently operational, but Google expects a V4 version capable of about 200 metric tons to achieve the $200/kg price point
Travis Beals is senior director of Project Suncatcher at Google
articles.conclusion: The partnership secures an early launch slot for Google’s space‑based AI infrastructure while highlighting the strategic importance of affordable heavy‑lift launch capacity for future orbital data‑center deployments.

articles.title: Players Encountering Bizarre Bugs in GTA VI
articles.que_paso: The newly released Grand Theft Auto VI, after a 13‑year development cycle, is already generating reports of severe technical glitches. Players have posted videos of characters falling through environments, ships mis‑aligning on bridges, and avatars becoming trapped, while some streamers and influencers are amplifying the issue to fuel cultural‑war narratives.
datos: Development of GTA VI spanned 13 years before its launch.
One player recorded a character falling through a prison floor into a void and reappearing on a busy road.
A streamer named Michael Does Life posted a clip of a glitch where a character is sucked into an office cubicle during a fight, likening it to Cyberpunk 2077.
The X account Grand Theft Auto 6 Alerts shared a video labeling the bug “literally unplayable.”
A 15‑minute‑into‑game player reported their avatar clipping through a cage wall and becoming trapped with no escape.
articles.conclusion: The bugs highlight the risk of releasing complex software without sufficient post‑launch validation, suggesting that robust QA and rapid patching are essential to protect brand reputation and maintain player trust.

articles.title: Whatever You Thought Texas Was, It’s Bigger and Bluer Than That
articles.que_paso: Democrats secured a win in Texas this November, ending a Republican winning streak that had persisted for multiple decades, prompting a debate about the state's identity.
datos: Democrats achieved a victory in Texas in November 2026.
The win ended a Republican winning streak that had lasted for several decades.
The event occurred within the state of Texas.
The article discussing the outcome was published on November 20, 2026.
articles.conclusion: The break in the long‑standing Republican dominance signals a potential shift in Texas politics, suggesting future elections may be more competitive and policy priorities could change.

articles.title: La RAE reúne en la Mezquita-Catedral de Córdoba a 21 académicos en un pleno extraordinario dedicado a Góngora
articles.que_paso: La Real Academia Española organizó una sesión pública en la Mezquita‑Catedral de Córdoba, reuniendo a 21 académicos para conmemorar el 400.º aniversario de la muerte del poeta Luis de Góngora. El acto formó parte de los eventos programados para 2027 en honor al escritor cordobés.
datos: 21 académicos asistieron al pleno extraordinario
La sesión se celebró en la Mezquita‑Catedral de Córdoba
Fue un pleno extraordinario convocado por la Real Academia Española
Se conmemoró el cuarto centenario de la muerte de Luis de Góngora
Luis de Góngora falleció en 1667
Los actos forman parte de la programación cultural del año 2027
articles.conclusion: El evento subraya el compromiso institucional con la difusión del patrimonio literario español y refuerza la vigencia de Góngora como referencia cultural para la educación y la gestión de eventos en el sector cultural.

articles.title: FCC greenlights rule allowing prisons to jam cellphone signals
articles.que_paso: The Federal Communications Commission adopted a unanimous rule permitting state and local prisons to install cellphone‑jamming equipment. The measure was promoted by FCC Chair Brendan Carr and faced opposition from industry groups and civil‑rights organizations over potential interference with lawful calls.
datos: The FCC vote was unanimous, allowing state and local correctional facilities to use jamming devices.
Section 333 of the Communications Act of 1934 generally bans the use of jammers.
Chair Brendan Carr said the rule will help stop inmates from using phones to order hits, run drug operations, and traffic people.
The US Chamber of Commerce and the CTIA warned the rule could block lawful communications, including 911 calls.
Commissioner Anna Gomez, the sole Democrat on the commission, voted for the rule despite concerns about unintended consequences.
The FCC requires prisons to obtain a license, meet technical standards, and notify nearby communities before deploying jamming technology.
articles.conclusion: The rule could reduce contraband phone abuse in prisons, but it also introduces risks of disrupting emergency services and raises civil‑rights issues, making compliance and community notification critical.

articles.title: Bleeding Through Guitarist John Arnold Is Recovering From A Heart Attack
articles.que_paso: Bleeding Through guitarist John Arnold was hospitalized after suffering a heart attack, and the band posted an online statement on November 19 urging fans to cherish loved ones. Arnold indicated his intention to leave the hospital and resume performing with both Bleeding Through and his side project Cerebellion.
datos: John Arnold is the guitarist for the veteran metalcore band Bleeding Through.
He suffered a heart attack and was hospitalized.
The band announced the incident on November 19, 2026 via an online post.
The posted message read: “Let this remind us all to always tell your people you love them. Life is precious.”
Arnold expressed a goal to return to the stage with Bleeding Through and the side project Cerebellion.
articles.conclusion: His recovery timeline will affect upcoming tour dates and highlights the importance of health awareness for touring musicians.

articles.title: You can now buy a Steam Machine without getting on a waitlist
articles.que_paso: Valve has opened direct purchase for its 512GB Steam Machine, removing the previous waitlist requirement, while the 2TB version remains unavailable and its waitlist is being closed. The 512GB units are listed with an estimated delivery window of three to five business days, whereas the 2TB units have more demand than supply.
datos: Valve announced the change on November 20, 2026.
The 512GB Steam Machine is priced at $1,049 without a controller.
The 2TB Steam Machine is priced at $1,349 without a controller.
Estimated delivery for the 512GB model is three to five business days.
Valve launched the Steam Machine in June 2026 after delaying the early‑2026 launch due to a memory and storage crisis.
The waitlist for the 2TB model is being closed because demand exceeds available units.
articles.conclusion: The immediate availability of the 512GB model lets operations teams acquire hardware quickly for AI workloads, but the scarcity of the 2TB version means capacity planning must account for limited high‑storage units.

articles.title: Nvidia se enfrenta a una nueva amenaza tras la destitución de Jensen Huang: la pérdida de sus mejores ingenieros
articles.que_paso: Tras la destitución de Jensen Huang, el consejo nombró a Colette Kress como CEO interina y anunció aumentos salariales y más acciones para los ingenieros de Nvidia durante la presentación de resultados del tercer trimestre, con el objetivo de evitar una fuga de talento hacia la nueva empresa de Huang. La medida se produce en medio de una caída de $550.000 millones en el valor de mercado de la compañía y una petición de 180.000 firmas para que Huang regrese.
datos: Nvidia reportó ingresos de 115.800 millones de dólares en el tercer trimestre, un 103 % más que el año anterior.
El valor de mercado de Nvidia ha disminuido en aproximadamente 550.000 millones de dólares desde la destitución de Huang.
La compensación mediana de un ingeniero en Nvidia es de 233.675 euros al año, según Levels.fyi.
El plan de compra de acciones para empleados ha incrementado su valor un 3.776 % desde 2019, según Fortune.
Se estima que la pérdida de entre cinco y diez líderes técnicos tendría un efecto desproporcionado en la empresa, según Brad Gastwirth de Circular Technology.
articles.conclusion: Retener a los ingenieros clave es esencial para que Nvidia mantenga su ventaja en el diseño de chips y recupere el valor perdido; los incentivos salariales y de acciones buscan estabilizar la plantilla en un momento de vulnerabilidad competitiva.

articles.title: Dustin Moskovitz, an Early Anthropic Investor, Feels a Bit Uneasy About the IPO
articles.que_paso: Dustin Moskovitz, a Facebook co‑founder, sees his early stake in AI startup Anthropic increase in value as the company moves toward an initial public offering, but he has expressed discomfort about the upcoming IPO.
datos: Dustin Moskovitz co‑founded Facebook in 2004
Moskovitz invested in Anthropic during its seed round
Anthropic, an artificial‑intelligence research company, announced plans for an IPO in 2026
Moskovitz publicly said he feels uneasy about the IPO
Anthropic’s valuation has risen since Moskovitz’s investment
articles.conclusion: His unease signals that even successful early backers are cautious about taking AI firms public, suggesting potential volatility for investors and the need for careful market timing.

articles.title: La Policía sanciona a un delegado sindical por publicar en redes una imagen suya sujetando por los grilletes a dos detenidos
articles.que_paso: La Dirección General de la Policía suspendió durante tres meses de empleo y sueldo a David Gutiérrez, delegado sindical de la CEP adscrito a la Jefatura Superior de Policía de Madrid, por publicar sin autorización varias imágenes suyas en Instagram, entre ellas una sujetando a dos detenidos con la leyenda "busted". La sanción se basa en dos infracciones graves del régimen disciplinario y el agente ha anunciado que recurrirá la medida ante los tribunales.
datos: David Gutiérrez, portavoz del sindicato CEP, recibió una suspensión total de tres meses de empleo y sueldo
La primera sanción de un mes se originó por una historia de Instagram publicada el 14 de diciembre de 2025
El documento de la DGP que propone la sanción está fechado el 10 de julio de 2026
Las otras tres imágenes fueron difundidas el 27 de mayo y el 25 de junio de 2024 y el 1 de agosto de 2025
Las infracciones se encuadran en el artículo 8, apartados X y S, del régimen disciplinario de la Policía Nacional
articles.conclusion: La medida refuerza la normativa sobre el uso de redes sociales por parte del personal policial y advierte a otros agentes sobre las consecuencias de divulgar imágenes sin autorización, lo que puede afectar la imagen institucional y las relaciones sindicales.

articles.title: Periphery Dropped An Ocarina Solo Into Their Live Set Via The New ‘The Legend Of Zelda’ Remake
articles.que_paso: Spencer Sotelo, guitarist for Periphery, added a digital ocarina solo to a live rendition of their song “Wildfire” this week, using a Nintendo Switch 2 and the newly remade The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. The performance aligned with the release of a new ocarina peripheral bundled with the game remake.
datos: Spencer Sotelo performed a digital ocarina solo during a live version of “Wildfire” this week.
He used a Nintendo Switch 2 console and a copy of the new remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.
A new ocarina peripheral was released alongside the remake of the game.
The original The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time was first released in 1998.
The game has been widely hailed as the best video game of all time.
articles.conclusion: The move illustrates how metal bands are adopting gaming hardware to create novel live‑performance elements, offering a practical model for integrating interactive tech into concerts.

articles.title: Extraditado a EEUU un coronel retirado de Bolivia acusado de tráfico de drogas y de armas
articles.que_paso: El jueves, Bolivia entregó a Henry Richard Crespo Guzmán, coronel retirado de las Fuerzas Armadas, a la justicia estadounidense tras la solicitud de EE. UU., por presuntos vínculos con el narcotráfico y el tráfico de armas.
datos: Henry Richard Crespo Guzmán es un coronel retirado de las Fuerzas Armadas de Bolivia
La extradición se realizó el jueves
Estados Unidos ha solicitado su entrega por supuestos delitos de narcotráfico y tráfico de armas
La autoridad boliviana que realizó la entrega fue el Ministerio de Gobierno
El caso se enmarca en la cooperación judicial entre Bolivia y EE. UU.
articles.conclusion: La medida refuerza la colaboración bilateral en materia de seguridad y alerta sobre la presencia de personal militar retirado en redes ilícitas.

articles.title: La encuesta antes del debate: ligera ventaja del PP y muy clara del bloque derechista
articles.que_paso: El debate cara a cara entre Pedro Sánchez y Alberto Feijóo se celebra mientras el último tracking de 40dB muestra al PP con una ligera ventaja de dos puntos sobre el PSOE, dentro de un margen de error del 2,2 %. Ambos bloques presentan proyecciones de escaños diferentes y Sánchez intenta usar el debate para reducir la brecha en la preferencia presidencial y estimular la participación electoral.
datos: El PP lidera al PSOE por 2 puntos según la encuesta de 40dB del jueves
El margen de error de la encuesta es del 2,2 %
Se proyectan 192 escaños para el bloque de Feijóo frente a 155 para los partidos que apoyan al Gobierno de Sánchez
El PP obtendría 132 diputados, cuatro menos que la cifra actual, al contar la coalición con UPN en Navarra
El PSOE alcanzaría 120 diputados, uno menos que en 2023
El 31,8 % de los encuestados prefieren a Sánchez como presidente frente al 23,1 % que prefieren a Feijóo
articles.conclusion: La estrecha ventaja del PP y la baja previsión de participación hacen que la movilización de votantes sea crucial para que el PSOE pueda revertir la tendencia en la jornada electoral.

articles.title: La defensora del pueblo en funciones elimina el área de Igualdad y diluye la de Migraciones un día después de asumir el cargo
articles.que_paso: La defensora del pueblo en funciones, Teresa Jiménez‑Becerril, reestructuró la oficina eliminando el área de Igualdad y reduciendo la de Migraciones apenas un día después de asumir el cargo.
datos: Teresa Jiménez‑Becerril, exdiputada del Partido Popular, asumió como defensora del pueblo en funciones el 19 de noviembre de 2026.
El puesto quedó vacante tras la expiración del mandato de Ángel Gabilondo.
En la reestructuración, el área de Igualdad fue suprimida completamente.
El área de Migraciones fue diluida, integrándose parcialmente en otras unidades de la Defensoría.
La decisión se comunicó mediante un comunicado interno de la Defensoría el 20 de noviembre de 2026.
articles.conclusion: La medida indica un cambio de prioridades institucionales que podría limitar la atención a la igualdad de género y a los derechos de los migrantes en el ámbito español.

articles.title: How Much Do You Know About NASA’s Voyager Mission?
articles.que_paso: An educational article from NASA uses a quiz format to spotlight the Voyager missions and a range of current space topics, linking the historic Golden Record to modern initiatives such as astronaut recruitment and recent discoveries. It references the signal delay from Voyager 1, the potential for life in sulfuric acid, a Martian meteorite found in the Sahara, and a newly identified dwarf‑planet candidate, 2026 ED138, discovered by the Vera C. Rubin Observatory.
datos: Both Voyager 1 and Voyager 2 carry a Golden Record containing sounds and images of Earth
NASA is recruiting its next class of astronauts for low‑Earth‑orbit and lunar missions
A meteorite discovered in the Sahara four years ago was identified as a piece of Mars dating back 4.1 billion years
The object designated 2026 ED138, spotted beyond Pluto, is one of the first dwarf‑planet candidates found by the Vera C. Rubin Observatory in Chile
articles.conclusion: The piece reinforces public interest in space science while highlighting concrete operational developments—new astronaut cohorts and recent extraterrestrial findings—that can inform strategic planning in technology and operations.

articles.title: Marsha Linehan Has Died. She Transformed Treatment for Personality Disorder.
articles.que_paso: Marsha Linehan, the psychologist who created dialectical behavior therapy, has passed away, and her recent public admission that she herself struggled with borderline personality disorder as a child adds personal context to her professional legacy.
datos: Marsha Linehan died.
She transformed treatment for personality disorder.
Her therapeutic methods proved effective.
She disclosed she had battled borderline personality disorder during childhood.
articles.conclusion: Her death closes a seminal career while her personal revelation underscores the credibility of DBT and may encourage openness about clinicians' own mental‑health experiences.

articles.title: "You’re right"—LLMs will get climate info wrong if you ask
articles.que_paso: Researchers from University College London and UNESCO evaluated 33 large language models, including frontier systems like Claude Fable 5 and GPT‑5.6 Sol, on 600 climate‑related benchmark questions to see how accurately they recall facts and assess policy impacts.
datos: 33 models were tested
600 questions were used across multiple benchmark sets
Flagship frontier models answered about 78% of confidence‑in‑scientists questions correctly, while the smallest open‑weight models answered about 47%
For standard factual benchmarks, frontier and large open‑weight models scored roughly 90% and small open‑weight models scored in the 70s
When asked to evaluate evidence, the best models achieved around 70% accuracy and the worst fell below 40%
Single‑policy impact questions were answered correctly between 72% and 89%, but combined‑policy and magnitude questions performed at random‑guess levels
articles.conclusion: The mixed performance shows LLMs can provide misleading climate policy advice, so operators must verify outputs before relying on them for decisions.

articles.title: "Nunca he usado Ozempic. Nunca me he sometido a ninguna cirugía facial": la actriz Florence Pugh critica las especulaciones sobre su cuerpo
articles.que_paso: Florence Pugh respondió a la oleada de comentarios sobre su apariencia tras su aparición en los Governors Awards, negando haber usado Ozempic o haberse sometido a cirugía facial y expresando su molestia por la presión pública sobre su cuerpo.
datos: Publicó un mensaje en Instagram donde afirma 'Nunca he usado Ozempic. Nunca me he sometido a ninguna cirugía facial'.
Indicó haber perdido un kilogramo y que su objetivo principal es desarrollar músculo.
Mencionó que ahora puede hacer seis flexiones en barra y levantar 110 kg.
Fue nominada al Oscar por 'Mujercitas' en 2020 y ha interpretado a Yelena Belova en 'Spider‑Man: Brand New Day'.
La profesora Heather Widdows, de Everyday Lookism, comentó a BBC News que los estándares de belleza están cambiando y son cada vez más imposibles de cumplir.

articles.title: Anthropic Stock Sputters After Historic IPO
articles.que_paso: Anthropic’s debut on the public market saw its stock spike above $111 before quickly dropping below $100 and settling near $97, marking a volatile start for the first pure‑AI company to list. The offering occurred amid heightened investor caution over AI‑related debt, data‑center spending, and a recent scandal involving Nvidia’s CEO, which together dampened market enthusiasm.
datos: The IPO price was $83 per share, with the opening price exceeding $111 before falling to about $97.
Anthropic’s market capitalization after the IPO was estimated at over $1.3 trillion, short of the $2 trillion originally projected.
The company reported a $42 billion loss in the most recent fiscal year, surpassing its 2024 losses.
Revenue grew twelve‑fold in 2025 compared with the prior year.
SpaceX’s public valuation in June was $1.75 trillion, providing a recent benchmark for large tech IPOs.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned the week before the IPO amid allegations of ties to a Chinese spy, prompting regulatory scrutiny of the AI sector.
articles.conclusion: The sharp price swing and massive valuation gap highlight the risk of investing in AI firms lacking profitability, underscoring the need for rigorous financial scrutiny before allocating operational budgets to such ventures.
